authoritative_control.authority: Puerto Rico Department of Health — Programa de Supervisión de Sistemas Públicos de Agua Potable

diagnostic_only_not_identity.rule: PWSID prefix, owner type, phone, organization name, and count arithmetic are not sufficient to assign PRASA/Non-PRASA authority identity.

hard_guardrails: Do not select 463 of EPA's 464 active systems by deletion or nearest-match logic.
Do not equate PR000 PWSID prefix with PRASA ownership without authoritative binding.
Do not use phone number, owner code, organization name, normalized name, or count equality as identity.
Current EPA 2026Q3 active count 464 is context only and does not supersede PRDOH's 463 control.
Certification requires an authoritative PRDOH member inventory or authoritative per-member crosswalk sufficient to enumerate all 463 control members.
required_next_evidence: Authoritative PRDOH 463-member system inventory with stable identifiers, or equivalent authoritative crosswalk
Manifestation bytes or reproducible API/export receipt
Per-member PRASA/Non-PRASA classification sufficient to reproduce 160+303
Per-member reconciliation against EPA SDWIS with accepted/rejected/falsifier states
